title: Find the satin move
intro: A satin hides its interlacings: on every pick one end goes down, and on the next pick that point moves on by a fixed number of ends, the move. Pick the number of shafts and the move so that the points never sit side by side and never form a diagonal line.
satinsLabel: Distinct regular satins on these shafts
drawdownTitle: Drawdown (dark: warp on top), with the threading above and the lift plan on the right
